normalizationPolicy: All payload bytes are preserved after lossless JSON gzip. No normalization was required or performed. Public Three.js scene UUIDs/references are preserved only in the explicitly reviewed E1/E2 scene fields; unexpected UUIDs, private paths or system identity fields fail closed. Original and decoded/stored archive hashes are separate.
sourceToPublicNumericEquality: Decoded bytes are identical, preserving every JSON numeric token, structure, string, UUID and negative zero.
